question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个院系的平均选课学生数，按院系的课程汇总的选课人数均值，排除退课，返回两年院系平均选课人数前5，按2025均值降序。
finding: 两年course结构缺失，模型未请求补表；案例已给COUNT DISTINCT学生，却选择COUNT(*)，并擅自扩展到全部院系、补0和多一列名称。输入不完整与粒度、空值、输出推理问题并存。
next_validation: 补完整课程/院系Schema，再固定去重对象、院系集合和NULL策略。

reference.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个院系的平均选课学生数，按院系的课程汇总的选课人数均值，排除退课，返回两年院系平均选课人数前5，按2025均值降序。
reference.query: WITH e2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2024 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2024) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024 FROM e2024 GROUP BY department_id), e2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY c.department_id, e.course_id), a2025 AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(enroll_cnt_2025) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM e2025 GROUP BY department_id) SELECT COALESCE(a2024.department_id,a2025.department_id) AS department_id, ROUND(a2024.avg_enroll_per_course_2024,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_enroll_per_course_2025,2) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.department_id=a2025.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_per_course_2025 DESC, department_id ASC LIMIT 5;

predicted.query: WITH d2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2024 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id), d2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id) SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, ROUND(COALESCE(d2024.avg_enroll_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2024, ROUND(COALESCE(d2025.avg_enroll_2025, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM education_2025.department d LEFT JOIN d2024 ON d2024.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN d2025 ON d2025.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_2025 DESC, d.department_id ASC LIMIT 5;

source_semantic_review: COUNT(*)代替每课程COUNT DISTINCT学生；从全部2025院系左连接而非从有2025选课均值的院系起步，并补0且多输出院系名称，群体/粒度/列均变化。enrollment未声明学生课程组合唯一。

rule_priority_excerpts: 本次问题的统一口径如下，优先于训练案例及不明确的知识描述：

2.公式算出来的比率类、平均值类结果，以及每股类指标，包括资产负债率、总资产收益率、市盈率、每股现金分红 DPS 等，用 ROUND(..., 2)。

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 统计2024与2025学期一中课程选择人数差，即2025减2024，差值最大的前5门课程，去重学生并排除退课，返回课程编号、课程名与差值。

steps.query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2025.cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.cnt_2024,0) AS diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_cnt_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 5;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 统计学期一中每个院系选课人数，去重学生，并返回院系编号与选课人数，按选课人数降序取前10。

steps.query: SELECT c.department_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id ORDER BY active_enroll_student_cnt DESC, c.department_id ASC LIMIT 10;
